$description: Motion design tokens for Mission Platform — transition/animation durations and easing (timing-function) curves. Replaces the inline `150ms ease` literals scattered across the component library with named, reusable values.

duration.$description: Transition/animation duration scale, from fast press-feedback to slow enter/exit. The default UI transition is `fast` (150ms).

quick.$description: 100ms — compact navigation-item hover and active feedback.

fast.$description: 150ms — the default UI transition (colour, border, shadow, opacity).

easing.$description: Named easing (timing-function) curves. `standard` is the default UI easing.
